bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to family law; requiring certain intended parents to adopt the child; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 257E.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[257E.28] EXCEPTION; ADOPTION REQUIRED. +]

[+Notwithstanding sections 257E.15 to 257E.27, an intended parent who is not biologically related to the child and does not give birth to the child is not a parent of the child and must not be adjudicated as the parent of the child, unless the intended parent adopts the child pursuant to chapter 259. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective August 1, 2026, and applies to births on or after that date. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to family law; requiring certain intended parents to adopt the child; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 257E.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[257E.28] EXCEPTION; ADOPTION REQUIRED.

Notwithstanding sections 257E.15 to 257E.27, an intended parent who is not biologically related to the child and does not give birth to the child is not a parent of the child and must not be adjudicated as the parent of the child, unless the intended parent adopts the child pursuant to chapter 259.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective August 1, 2026, and applies to births on or after that date.
additions: Notwithstanding sections 257E.15 to 257E.27, an intended parent who is not biologically related to the child and does not give birth to the child is not a parent of the child and must not be adjudicated as the parent of the child, unless the intended parent adopts the child pursuant to chapter 259.
This section is effective August 1, 2026, and applies to births on or after that date.
